name: Plank Up-Down
steps: Begin in a high-plank position on the floor with your palms beneath your shoulders and your feet set slightly wider than hip-width.
Brace your core to keep your hips steady, then lower one forearm down to the floor followed by the other into a forearm plank.
Place your first palm back beneath your shoulder and press up, followed by the second arm, returning to the high plank.
Switch which arm leads the descent and press on the next repetition, alternating sides continuously.
tips: Keep your hips as square to the floor as possible instead of rocking sharply from side to side.
Place each palm directly underneath your shoulder rather than far out in front of you.
